tenant.description: Tenant sent to the backend in the X-Calendar-Tenant header.

storageMode.description: Where events are stored: in the browser or in the backend.

apiTimeoutMs.description: Timeout of a backend request in milliseconds.

features.description: Optional features. Everything left out keeps its default.

auth.description: Sign-in, registration and accounts. Needs a backend.

teams.description: Team calendars, members, roles and invitations. Needs a backend and sign-in.

chat.description: Chat per event in team calendars. Needs teams, the chat endpoints and the WebSocket.

attendees.description: Inviting team members to events and replying to invitations. Needs teams.

recurrence.description: Creating and editing recurring events. Existing series are still shown.

reminders.description: Reminders on events and their notifications in the browser.

links.description: Website and other links on events.

mapLinks.description: Opening an event location in a map service.

holidays.description: Public holidays in the views and their setting.

undo.description: Undo after moving or deleting an event. When off, deleting asks for confirmation.

subscriptions.description: Subscription links (iCalendar feeds) in the calendar settings. Needs the feed endpoints.

importExport.description: Import and export of iCalendar files in the calendar settings.

emailNotifications.description: The e-mail notification settings of a signed-in user.

timeZones.description: Choosing a time zone per event and in the settings. When off, the automatic time zone is used.

categories.description: Categories per calendar, assigning them to events and filtering the views by them. Needs the category endpoints.

publicLinks.description: Public read-only links to a calendar, and the page they open. Needs the share endpoints.

views.description: The views a user can switch between. All four by default.

routing.description: memory keeps navigation inside the widget, browser uses the address bar.

linkParam.description: Query parameter of the host page that carries links from e-mails, or false to turn it off.

locale.description: Language and region, for example de or en-GB.

messages.description: Text overrides per language. Only plain texts can be overridden from a file.

theme.description: Theme used while the user has chosen the system theme.

initialView.description: View shown first. Overrides the user's start view.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone used while the user has chosen the automatic time zone.

holidays.description: Region for public holidays such as DE or DE-NW, or off.

readOnly.description: Shows events without letting anyone create, change, move, delete or import them.

appearance.description: Look of the calendar. The same can be set from CSS with the --calendar-* custom properties.

accentColor.description: Color of buttons, links, today and the selection, as a CSS color such as #e63946.

fontFamily.description: CSS font family, for example Inter, sans-serif. The font itself must be loaded by your page.

radius.description: Corner radius in pixels. 0 gives square corners.

density.description: compact uses smaller text, rows and spacing.
